mapping_ids.314: Long term total demand, filtered to category=natural_gas (314 also carries oil_products, NGLs, liquids for the same countries; those are out of scope here)

scope: country-level rows only (country_iso populated); region and world aggregate rows excluded
method: net_bcm = supply_bcm - demand_bcm per country_iso2, ranked descending; top 25 positive (net-long) and top 25 negative (net-short) tagged as material
caveat: Single forecast year (2026), not checked for rank stability across the full 2025-2050 horizon. Accepted as sufficient for a node/port/geometry materiality threshold, not for the balance itself. See LT_LNG_flows_forecast_plan.md 4.3c.

not_in_series.note: Checked directly and absent from both mapping 297 and 314 country-level rows
